Package it.polimi.ingsw.network.messages.server

package it.polimi.ingsw.network.messages.server
  • Class
    Description
    AvailableLobbiesMessage
    Sent by the server in response to an AskLobbiesMessage, carrying the current list of open game lobbies.
    ChangeAgeUpdateMessage
    Broadcast by the server to all clients when the game advances to a new age, carrying the refreshed card rows and deck size.
    CurrPlayerUpdateMessage
    Broadcast by the server to all clients when the active player changes.
    DrawUpdateMessage
    Broadcast by the server to all clients when a player draws a card.
    ErrorMessage
    Sent by the server to relay a generic error message to the client.
    EventMessage
    Sent by the server when one or more card effects are resolved during a turn, carrying the triggered events and the resulting player statistics.
    GameCreatedMessage
    Sent by the server to the player who created a lobby, confirming the creation and providing the assigned match ID.
    GameEndingUpdateMessage
    Sent by the server to each client when the game ends, carrying the final statistics and the recipient player's ranking positions.
    GameJoinedMessage
    Sent by the server to a player who successfully joined an existing lobby, confirming the match ID they have entered.
    LoginFailedMessage
    Sent by the server when a login request is rejected.
    LoginSuccessMessage
    Sent by the server to confirm that a login request was accepted.
    MoveUpdateMessage
    Broadcast by the server to all clients when a player places their pawn on a board tile.
    NotifyDrawableMessage
    Sent by the server to the active player when they become eligible to draw one or more cards, carrying the updated action budget.
    NotifySkipMessage
    Broadcast by the server to all clients when a player skips their remaining actions for the current turn.
    PhaseUpdateMessage
    Broadcast by the server to all clients when the game transitions to a new phase.
    QuitAckMessage
    Sent by the server to acknowledge a QuitMessage, confirming that the player has been removed from the match and providing a reason or summary message.
    RankingResponseMessage
    Sent by the server in response to a RankingRequestMessage, carrying the global leaderboard: the cumulative score each player has accumulated across all matches played with the same number of players.
    ReconnectionMessage
    Sent by the server to a client that has reconnected to an ongoing match, providing the match ID so the client can restore its state.
    RequestLeaderboardUpdateMessage
    Sent by the server after the game ends with the global leaderboard, mapping each player to their overall position across all matches.
    ReturnToQueueUpdateMessage
    Sent by the server to a player who has been returned to the waiting queue.
    ServerMessage
    Marker interface for all messages sent from the server to a client over a socket connection.
    ShowBoardMessage
    Sent by the server with the full board state, typically at game start or after a client reconnects, so the client can rebuild its local model.
    StatsUpdateMessage
    Sent by the server when a player's statistics change.
    StatusUpdateMessage
    Sent by the server when a player's status flags change.
